component.name: Triple-C
component.summary: Run Claude Code sessions in isolated Docker containers

description.p: Triple-C sandboxes Claude Code inside per-project Docker containers, so an agent can install packages, edit files and run commands without touching the host. Each project gets its own container, its own credentials and its own terminal sessions.

ul.li: Per-project containers with persistent home and config volumes
Multiple terminal sessions per project, in one reorderable tab strip
Notes that can be sent straight into a running agent's prompt
Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Ollama, llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible backends
Remote access over a browser terminal, and speech-to-text input
